headlines.title: There’s a Better AI Picks-and-Shovels Choice Between GE Vernova and Constellation Energy
headlines.summary: GE Vernova and Constellation both feed the AI power boom, but their Q2 results reveal a widening gap in momentum, valuation, and regulatory risk that points toward one clearer opportunity for investors right now.

headlines.title: GE Vernova Customers Receive Three 2026 POWER Magazine Awards
headlines.summary: Several GE Vernova (NYSE:GEV) customers received recognition in the 2026 POWER Awards for power generation projects using the company’s technologies. The annual awards programme, organised by POWER Magazine, recognises projects and performance across the electricity generation industry.

headlines.title: GE Vernova’s Consolidation Looks Promising For One Simple Reason
headlines.summary: GE Vernova's cash outlook just surged while the stock sat still, and that gap between price and reality has analysts lining up on one side of the trade.

headlines.title: GE Vernova's BWRX-300 Secures First US Construction Permit
headlines.summary: GEV wins the first U.S. construction permit for its BWRX-300 SMR, strengthening its nuclear pipeline and long-term growth opportunity.

headlines.title: GE Vernova (GEV) vs. Quanta Services (PWR): Which AI Power Stock Has More Room to Run?
headlines.summary: The AI boom is creating a problem that has little to do with chips. Data centers need enormous amounts of electricity, but generating, transmitting, and connecting that power can take years. That is turning power infrastructure into one of the most important parts of the AI investment cycle. GE Vernova Inc.

description: GE Vernova Inc., an energy company, engages in the provision of various products and services that generate, transfer, orchestrate, convert, and store electricity in the United States, Europe, Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. The company operates through three segments: Power, Wind, and Electrification. The Power segment designs, manufactures, and services gas, nuclear, hydro, and steam technologies. It serves industrial, government, and other customers. The Wind segment offers wind generation technologies, including onshore and offshore wind turbines and blades. The Electrification segment provides grid solutions; power conversion; electrification software; and solar and storage solutions technologies required for the transmission, distribution, conversion, storage, and orchestration of electricity from point of generation to point of consumption. The company was incorporated in 2023 and is headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts.
